about: Controlled vocabulary for image tags. Only these tags can ever be assigned. A 'single' facet gets exactly one tag per image; a 'multi' facet gets between none and 'max' tags. The definitions are the instructions followed when labelling, by a person or by a model. Colour is measured from the pixels and is not labelled by hand. Change a label or definition here, correct the labels in data/tags/labels.csv, and re-run tools/tag_images.py.

tags.label: Cover
tags.definition: Front cover of a book, novelette or magazine, with its printed title.

tags.label: Photograph
tags.definition: A photograph, including photographic postcards and photographs reproduced in print, shown on its own.

tags.label: Illustration
tags.definition: A drawing, painting or print that is not chiefly comic: plates and inside illustrations, vignettes, art prints.

tags.label: Caricature
tags.definition: A comic or satirical drawing or cartoon, with or without a caption.

tags.label: Press page
tags.definition: A page from a magazine or newspaper that mixes text with pictures.

tags.label: Advertisement
tags.definition: A printed advertisement for a product, service or publication.

tags.label: Text page
tags.definition: A page of text only, such as a title page, with no picture or only a small ornament.

tags.label: One woman
tags.definition: A single female figure.

tags.label: One man
tags.definition: A single male figure.

tags.label: Couple
tags.definition: One man and one woman.

tags.label: Women together
tags.definition: Two or more women and no men.

tags.label: Group
tags.definition: Any other combination of several people, including two men or a crowd.

tags.label: No figure
tags.definition: No person is shown.

tags.label: Nude
tags.definition: The main figure, or the least dressed figure, is fully naked or wears only shoes, stockings or jewellery.

tags.label: Semi-nude
tags.definition: Partly dressed with breasts, buttocks or genitals uncovered.

tags.label: Lingerie or swimwear
tags.definition: In underwear, corset, negligee, nightdress or swimsuit, with nothing uncovered.

tags.label: Clothed
tags.definition: Every figure is dressed in day, evening or stage clothes.

tags.label: No figure
tags.definition: No person is shown.

tags.label: Portrait
tags.definition: Head and shoulders, or bust, of one sitter.

tags.label: Performance
tags.definition: Dance, cabaret, theatre, circus or music: a performer on stage or posing in stage costume.

tags.label: Bathing or beach
tags.definition: Bathing, the beach, the bath or washing.

tags.label: Bedroom or boudoir
tags.definition: A bed, couch, dressing table or other private interior is part of the scene.

tags.label: Outdoors
tags.definition: Set in a garden, the countryside, a street or other open-air place.

tags.label: Kiss or embrace
tags.definition: Two figures kissing, embracing or caressing.

tags.label: Sexual act
tags.definition: An explicit sexual act is shown.

tags.label: Humour or satire
tags.definition: The picture is meant to be funny or to mock someone.

tags.label: Myth or fantasy
tags.definition: Mythological, allegorical, religious, orientalist or supernatural subject: nymphs, devils, odalisques and the like.

tags.label: Smoking
tags.definition: A figure smokes or holds a cigarette, cigar or pipe.

tags.label: Sport or exercise
tags.definition: Sport, gymnastics, dancing for exercise or physical culture.

tags.label: Medical or scientific
tags.definition: Anatomical, medical or scientific picture or diagram.

tags.label: Fashion
tags.definition: Fashionable dress, hats or hairstyle are the point of the picture.
